name: sandboxing rejects right-to-left override in conflict message
description: Schema rejects U+202E (RTL override) in conflict.notify.conflicts[].message. The message field is constrained to printable ASCII (0x20-0x7e); Unicode formatting characters fall outside that set.
notes: Pattern: bidirectional-rendering smuggling. Defended at the schema layer because conflict.notify.message is constrained to printable ASCII. The RTL override codepoint is JSON-escaped (legal in JSON either way) so the fixture file reads cleanly in editors.
